summary.motive: Attack 2-high / Cover 4 Quarters defenses using a two-man vertical stretch (Seam Pin + 15-yard Dig) over an underneath shallow drag crosser.
summary.whyItWorks: The vertical seam by TE1 forces the safeties to turn and run deep, while the shallow drag by X pulls the linebackers forward, creating a huge unobstructed intermediate window for the 15-yard Dig.
summary.failureMode: Mike linebacker sinking into the intermediate hole without respecting the shallow drag or defensive end batting down the pass at the line of scrimmage.

beats.title: 1. The Condensed Bunch Play-Action Mesh
beats.text: Under-center run fake from 2x2 bunch pulls Mike and Will linebackers downhill into their A/B gap run fits, opening intermediate passing lanes behind them.

beats.title: 2. The Dagger Seam Pin
beats.text: TE1 storms up the seam at full speed into the Cover 4 shell. Both the Free Safety and Strong Safety turn their hips and carry TE1 vertically 20+ yards downfield, pinning the top of the coverage.

beats.title: 3. The High-Low Conflict on the Mike
beats.text: X drags across at 3 yards depth, fixing the Mike linebacker’s eyes underneath. Above Mike and below the pinned safeties, a massive 15-yard void forms in the center of the field.

beats.title: 4. The 16-Yard Intermediate Dig Strike
beats.text: Z snaps his 90-degree square-in right into the heart of the void. QB delivers a dart on the numbers for a first down and huge run-after-catch opportunity.

relations.tell: Tight bunch alignment with TE1 bursting vertically up the seam rather than crossing behind the line of scrimmage.
